To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

it is possible to decrease the level and dynamics (decreasing of mortality) of malignant neoplasm on the territory of the region by means of variation (decreasing) of the level of managed factors of public health system, and the most effective way to decrease the level of mortality of neoplasm is to increase the number of health institutions and the level of medical care provided in them.
the impact of factors of public health system is possible to be considered as a factor of mortality of malignant diseases in Voronezh region.
the mortality from malignant neoplasma is the main problem of population health in Voronezh Oblast.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the possibility to impact level of population mortality by means of variation in activity of public health institutions.
the analysis of the impact of public health institutions on the level of mortality of neoplasm including malignant ones.
the impact of public health on the mortality of malignant neoplasm and the results can be used to develop a comprehensive program for reducing the incidence of malignant neoplams in the future.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the impact of managed public health factors on the level and dynamics in mortality of malignant neoplasm is possible.
there are no significant interdependencies between mortality of neoplastic diseases among the population of the Voronezh oblast and the indicators of activity of the health care system.
the level of mortality of neoplasm including malignant ones can be decreased by means of variation and improvement of condition and activity of health system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the level of mortality from malignant neoplasia can be decreased in Voronezh Oblast by means of variation the managed factors of public health system, which can be applied in the process of development of the State program for development of public health system in the Russian Federation and in the process of implementation of this program.
the level of mortality of neoplasm in Voronezh region is determined by the activity of health institutions, the number and density of health institutions, and by the number and density population.
the impact of managed public health factors is possible to be applied in planning of activities targeted to decrease of mortality of malignant tumors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the level of mortality of neoplasm in the population of Voronezh Oblast can be decreased to the level of 200 per 100 00 population in 2015 by means of variation the levels of managed factors.
the level of mortality of neoplasm can be reduced by means of variation in the levels of activity of public healthcare system.
the decrease of mortality from malignant neoplasma can be achieved through the improvement of the activity of health care system.
